acceptanceCriteria: A criterion form binding an external document by repository identity, object ID and span digest (or content digest plus declared locator), verified when that repository is supplied and reported NOT_OBSERVED otherwise; CEM spec amended with requirement IDs; tests.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1332. The plain criterion form requires criterionSha256 to equal the digest of an evidence span in the same repository at base, so requirements kept in a separate repository cannot be bound without copying.
title: cem plain criterion cannot bind a requirement kept in another repository
